activity_summary: After the call you said again that she wakes hoarse, as a girl would that had slept two days in a grave. You did not extend the death to six lines. You did not write the five words down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the page a longer death.

facets.activity: Said she wakes hoarse, and left the five words

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Then she wakes hoarse, as a girl would that had slept two days in a grave.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not give him six to make the mercy longer.
